title: AI Insight — Run an AI Risk Screening
purpose: Upload product photos and let AI identify compliance risks and requirements for your import region. You get a compliance guideline report (PDF).
meta: AI Insight (shown as “AI Risk Screening” in the QMAS menu)
https://qmas.icw.io/ai-risk-screening → **Add**, or a product profile → **AI Risk Screening** → **Add**
Tokens. Your balance shows as **Available Token** in the pop-up.
overview: Open **AI Risk Screening** from the left menu (or from a product profile) and click **Add**.
Upload up to 6 product photos and choose the **Import Region** and **Output Mode**.
Click **Verify Information** (recommended) or **Skip Verify & Generate Report**.
When the status is **Completed**, open the report from the list.

body: In the left menu, open **AI Risk Screening**. The list shows every screening with its import region, output mode (Full or Lite), status and upload date. Click **Add**.
You can also start from a product: open the product profile, choose **AI Risk Screening** in its left menu, then click **Add**.

body.caption: AI Risk Screening inside a product profile.

list: **Product Page URL** (optional): a link to the product page.
**Product Images** (required): up to 6 photos from different views. PNG, JPEG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF or HEIC.
**Import Region** (required): where the product will be sold.
**Screening Age Grade** (optional): the age grade to screen against, for example 3+ or 8+.

body: Click **Verify Information** (recommended: verification improves accuracy and gives a more reliable report), or **Skip Verify & Generate Report** to go straight to the report.
The new screening appears in the list. When its status is **Completed**, the report is ready. Click the **ⓘ** icon to see the screening details.

body.caption: Screening details: product name, import region, age grade, categories, materials, battery/AC/food-contact flags and output mode.

tips: Use clear photos from several angles (front, back, label, packaging) for a better result.
Check your Available Token balance before you generate.
faq: How do I run an AI risk screening / AI Insight?

Go to AI Risk Screening (https://qmas.icw.io/ai-risk-screening), click Add, upload product photos, choose Import Region and Output Mode, then click Verify Information or Skip Verify & Generate Report.
Where do I see my token balance?
In the AI Risk Screening pop-up, under Available Token.
What is the difference between Full and Lite?
They are the two report output modes. Choose one in Output Mode when you add a screening.
